plans.title: Hitta till rätt hållplatsläge vid Örebro Resecentrum (December 2024 v2)
plans.note: Linked from Jernhusen. Text gives bus stops and lines, and the symbols Taxi, Kiosk, Tågperrong, Kundcenter; no lifts, stairs or platform numbers.

open: All tunnel stairs and lifts are OSM only; no plan or owner text lists them. Platform 1a (south part of platform 1) has OSM stairs only at the south tunnel and no lift.
Signposted names of the three tunnels: none found.
Which shop Jernhusen means by 'en butik': not named; OSM has Pressbyrån at the building and Espresso House and Coffee Central nearby (Coffee Central at the south/Resecentrum end).
Where in the building the waiting room, Kundcenter, toilet and lockers are: no plan found.
Platform numbering: OSM has 1a, 1b, 3, 4; no owner source checked for current numbering.
